purpose: Connect the live property-title pathway, canonical property legal answer, evidence audit and public audit viewer into one traceable experience.

flow.question: Capture the user's property question and minimum necessary facts.
flow.classification: Determine the property issue and applicable route.
flow.official_route: Select the appropriate official property-record route.
flow.retrieval: Require an evidenced retrieval event before claiming an official record was obtained.
flow.evidence: Extract and verify only facts supported by the retrieved record.
flow.proposition: Map verified facts to canonical property propositions.
flow.legal_composition: Apply applicable law, temporal scope, conditions, exceptions and procedure.
flow.answer: Compose the canonical property legal answer.
flow.audit: Create the complete internal audit trail.

publication_guardrails: Do not claim an official property record was retrieved without a retrieval event and record evidence.
Do not convert extracted document wording directly into a legal conclusion without proposition and legal-rule mapping.
Do not publish an answer as verified when required primary evidence is missing or conflicting.
Preserve historical snapshots when the legal position changes.
Keep unresolved facts and evidence gaps visible.
Minimise personal data in public output.
